Team —

We need one final, tightly scoped pass on Q4 submission before the Friday freeze. Goal: a single source workbook and a ranked stakeholder slate we can share with Finance and GTM leadership. Please focus on only changes that materially affect commit (>$25k ARR impact) or stage movement.

Quick asks by EOD today:
- Karthik: flag any deals currently in Negotiation that lack signed PO dates or clear procurement owner. Add notes to the workbook under the "Needs PO" tab.
- Grace: sweep all Expansion and New Logo opportunities for contract length mismatches and call out any >60 day procurement risk.
- Ben: validate closed/won stamps on anything you believe already closed in the last 7 days; attach the export row id.
- Laura: prepare the stakeholder slate PDF (1 page) that lists the 5 highest-risk commits + recommended escalation owner. Use the template in Drive.

I've attached the latest workbook (v3) with my pass and a CSV export of recent closed deals. We'll consolidate edits and run a dry-run of the submission call tomorrow at 10:30 PT. Invite will go out shortly.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q4_forecast_workbook_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), closed_deals_export_oct20.csv (csv)]

Appreciate the quick turn, Karthik and Tim. A couple of operational notes ahead of the dry-run (tomorrow 10:30 PT):

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick alignment (5m) — who owns which escalation lines for the top 5 risky commits
2) Walk the risk matrix rows (12m) — each owner 2–3 mins to state the ask and ETA
3) Finance checklist (5m) — confirm workbook fields meet commit policy (ARR threshold, PO evidence, legal redlines acknowledged)
4) Final decisions & next steps (8m) — freeze or move to "watch"; publish stakeholder slate

Prep items (for dry-run):
- Everyone: have the workbook open and filtered to your ownership slice.
- Laura: bring stakeholder slate v2 as the meeting artifact.
- Ben: be ready to call out any immediate reclassifications (Closed -> Closed-Won) with supporting row ids.
